subject: Post-call recap + propose rotating windows for technical deep-dive
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anita Shah <anita@finsight.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 13:12:00 -0400
Subject: Post-call recap + propose rotating windows for technical deep-dive

Hi Anita (and Tom),

Thanks again for taking the time earlier — great to learn more about FinSight's analyst pipeline and latency constraints for live scoring. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we don't lose momentum:

- Goal: technical deep-dive/demo for FinSight engineering to validate inference throughput, latency under load, and data isolation options (VPC + KMS).
- Qualification highlights: SRE team is target owner; expected peak concurrent requests ~120 QPS with short sequences (avg 80 tokens); must support private deployment in EU for regulated PII.
- Decision timeline: procurement target is end of Q4; procurement and security review starting mid-September.

Next step: schedule a 60-minute technical deep-dive with your SRE + data infra folks, our infra engineer (Vanessa) and solutions lead (Priya). Because your team spans EU/APAC and we want to avoid repeatedly asking the same people to take calls outside local hours, I propose we pick a rotating meeting window for the weekly/biweekly deep-dive slot during the trial period so different regions take the on-call slot each week. Suggested rotation (three options) — please pick any that works or propose alternatives:

Option A (UTC-friendly, early US):
- Tue 16:00 UTC (US morning / EU late afternoon / APAC late night)
Option B (EU-first):
- Wed 09:30 UTC (EU morning / US early morning / APAC evening)
Option C (APAC-friendly):
- Thu 02:00 UTC (APAC morning / EU evening / US overnight)

If you prefer a single one-off deep-dive (no rotation) we can also propose a few concrete times next week. To help, share 2–3 slots that work for the SRE + data infra group and we'll lock it.

I've attached a short mutual action plan (MAP) that captures deliverables and owners for the trial. Vanessa, Priya — loop in the engineering calendar availability and we can generate a recurring invite once Anita confirms the preferred rotation or slot.

Thanks!
Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0142
Redwood Inference

Attachment: FinSight-MutualActionPlan-v1.pdf (1 page, summary)
From: Anita Shah <anita@finsight.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Becker <tom@finsight.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 20:45:00 +0530
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + propose rotating windows for technical deep-dive

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the clear recap — that aligns with our notes. We want to include our SRE lead (Tom) and one ML infra engineer (Rina Patel) on the technical deep-dive. A quick note on constraints from our side:

- Rina is based in Bangalore (IST +5:30) and prefers meetings between 09:00–18:00 IST.
- Tom is in London (BST) and is flexible but prefers not to be after 18:30 BST if possible.

Of your options, Option B (Wed 09:30 UTC) maps to 15:00 IST and 10:30 BST — that looks best for both Tom and Rina. We can do a one-off deep-dive next week and then evaluate rotation for the trial.

Available next-week windows (IST):
- Tue 2026-09-14: 15:00–16:30 IST
- Wed 2026-09-15: 15:00–16:30 IST (preferred)
- Thu 2026-09-16: 11:00–12:00 IST (backup)

Please pick Wed 15:00 IST if that works on your side and we'll confirm.

Regards,
Anita
CTO, FinSight

--

Subject: Re: Post-call recap + propose rotating windows for technical deep-dive

Thanks Anita — Wed 15:00 IST (Wed 09:30 UTC / Wed 05:30 BST / Wed 01:00 PDT) works for our infra lead as well.

I'll propose the one-off 60-minute deep-dive for 2026-09-15 09:30 UTC in the calendar and include a short runbook for the session: agenda, test plan, and a link to the minimal test dataset. Proposed agenda:
- 09:30–09:40 UTC: introductions & trial objectives (Jonas)
- 09:40–10:10 UTC: architecture deep-dive + security posture (Vanessa + Priya)
- 10:10–10:40 UTC: live load test & profiling (Rina + Vanessa)
- 10:40–10:50 UTC: next steps & actions (all)

Also — if FinSight wants to try a rotating weekly cadence after the first session, our recommended rotation is: Week A (APAC-friendly), Week B (EU-friendly), Week C (US-friendly). That keeps the burden distributed across timezones during the 6-week trial. We'll capture this in the MAP and surface expected on-call responsibilities.

Attaching the calendar invite stub and I'll update with the invite once Anita confirms.

Thanks,
Vanessa
Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
